1.title: Exam Technique and Final Review
1.text: Welcome to Module eighteen: Exam Technique and Final Review. This module covers pacing, method and final review. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do four things. A time plan for fifty-three items in one hundred twenty minutes. How to read an item, find the binding constraint and eliminate distractors. Multiple-response tactics. Policies and logistics, and what happens after the exam.

1.title: Case Check-In: Tidewater Insurance
1.text: Our running case is Tidewater Insurance. Tidewater Insurance. The developer meets the topic of this module. Your job: decide, step by step, which build choice fits.

1.title: Time Plan
1.text: Time Plan. The figure shows this: A three-part time plan: a quick first pass, a second pass for marked items, and a final check of multiple-response counts.

1.title: Time Plan, continued
1.text: Time Plan, continued. First pass. Time: about eighty min. What to do: Answer what you know in about ninety seconds per item; mark doubtful items. Second pass. Time: about thirty min. What to do: Return to marked items; use elimination. Final check. Time: about ten min. What to do: Every item answered; every multiple-response item has the required number of selections. With fifty-three items in one hundred twenty minutes you have about two minutes fifteen seconds per item: do not spend more than two minutes on one before marking it. The guide describes no deduction for wrong answers: answer every item. Exam tip: Mark a hard item and move on: it costs the time of two easy ones.

1.title: Reading an Item
1.text: Reading an Item. Read the last sentence first ("Which approach best...?") and note the number of answers to select. Find the binding constraint in the stem: latency, cost, security, reliability, compliance, maintainability. Predict the answer before you read the options.

1.title: Reading an Item, continued
1.text: Reading an Item, continued. "overnight", "non-urgent", "cost is the primary concern". Batch. "users wait", "interactive". Realtime (and streaming). "same prefix every request". Caching. "shared across several applications", "maintained independently". M C P (Model Context Protocol) server. "procedure", "checklist", "expertise". Skill. "must never", "destructive". Hook or deny rule. "untrusted", "hidden instructions", "third-party content". Data separation, least privilege, screening. "keys", "credentials". Secrets manager, rotation, server-side use. "unexpected wrong answers". Check what the model received; traces; evals. Exam tip: The cause is usually stated in the stem (a log line, a number, what the application sends): use it before choosing a fix.

1.title: Eliminating Distractors
1.text: Eliminating Distractors. Cross out answers that do not address the stated constraint (a bigger model for a security problem). Cross out over-engineering when a simple fix has not been tried (a classifier before better descriptions). Cross out absolute claims that ignore evals ("always the largest model"). Cross out answers that leave secrets in code, prompts or browsers. Between two valid answers, choose the enforced, measured, least-privileged, cost-aware one.

1.title: Multiple-response items
1.text: Multiple-response items. Choose exactly the number the stem asks for; judge each option on its own against the requirement. If you find one clear answer, the second is often the companion safeguard rather than a repeat of the first. Exam tip: When two answers both work, prefer the one that is enforced in code, measured by evals and least privileged.

1.title: Policies and Logistics
1.text: Policies and Logistics. Registration. Through the Anthropic Partner Academy and Pearson V U E; online proctored or test center. Reschedule or cancel. Up to twenty-four hours before; later changes forfeit the fee. I D. Valid government photo I D; the name must match the registration exactly. Accommodations. Request and get approval from Pearson V U E before scheduling. Agreements. You accept a confidentiality and non-disclosure agreement; never share exam content. Retakes. fourteen or thirty or ninety days; max four attempts per rolling twelve months. Result. Pass or fail and scaled score, plus percent correct per domain. Validity. twelve months from the award date.

1.title: Policies and Logistics, continued
1.text: Policies and Logistics, continued. The guide is version one point zero (July two thousand twenty-six); updated guides and exam content are announced for November and December two thousand twenty-six. Check the Partner Academy for the current guide, fee and eligibility before you book. As of eight November two thousand twenty-six.

1.title: Final Review Checklist
1.text: Final Review Checklist. [ ] I can state the ten decision rules without looking. [ ] I know realtime versus batch, caching rules, effort and thinking, and the error codes. [ ] I can choose between workflow and agent, and between built-in tool, custom tool, Skill and M C P. [ ] I know the model tiers and how to select and pin a model. [ ] I can explain prompt injection defenses, least privilege, hooks and key management. [ ] I know context engineering techniques and output validation. [ ] I can debug by classifying the failure and isolating the layer. [ ] I have built a small Claude application with a tool, a prompt, validation and an eval.

1.title: The last week
1.text: The last week. Seven to four days before: reread the notes of the heaviest domains (Applications and Integration, then Model Selection, then Agents) and redo their scenario questions; write down every item you got wrong and why. Three days before: work through the Decision Chooser in Module seventeen aloud, naming the deciding question for each row; reread the Names and Values table. The day before: light review only: the ten decision rules, the error codes and the time plan. Check your I D, registration name and test setup, and sleep.

1.title: The last week, continued
1.text: The last week, continued. On the day: arrive or log in early, read each item's last sentence first, and keep to the time plan.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Time: about ninety s per item first pass; mark and return; check multiple-response counts. Method: Last sentence first, binding constraint, predict, eliminate. Pick: Enforced, measured, least-privileged, cost-aware. Logistics: Photo I D with exact name, twenty-four-hour change rule, N D A (non-disclosure agreement), retakes fourteen or thirty or ninety days, valid twelve months. That completes the course. Good luck with the exam.
